snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | A-11 Extraction
snippet.description:
Let’s return to where it all began — Kraków, Nowa Huta!
We’re thrilled to present our Cronos: New Dawn live-action video, created in collaboration with the amazing team at Peep Cosplay.
Watch as the Traveler ND-3500 dives back to the 1980s, exploring an abandoned facility in Sector A-11 to harvest the essence of a key individual.

Production:
Bloober Team
Krótkie Kino (https://krotkiekino.pl/)
Music: 
Arkadiusz Reikowski
Cast: 
Traveler ND-3500 – Riccardo Peebes (Peep Cosplay Team)
Commander - Piotr Mielnik
Cat – Bella

Follow Peep Cosplay:
Instagram:  instagram.com/peep_cosplay_props
X: x.com/CosplayPeep

The game will arrive on September 5 to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order or Wishlist Cronos: The New Dawn! https://cronosnewdawn.com/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p7tflq7ctxn
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409
